WHAT: Retrieval v2 implemented with decay, intent classification, tighter signal thresholds — tuned against 119 real voice-transcribed messages

FINAL PARAMETER VALUES:
- MIN_ACTIVATION_SIGNALS: 2 (plan said 3 — too strict, reverted)
- maxMemories default: 3 (was 5)
- maxGlobalMemories: 1 (was 2)
- Content overlap threshold: 3 (plan said 4 — voice messages can't hit 4)
- Strong vector bypass: 0.50 (plan said 0.60 — reverted based on data)
- Vector signal threshold: 0.25 (was 0.30)
- Tag threshold: 1 for ≤4 tags, 2 for 5-7, 3 for 8+ (was flat 2)
- Importance floor: 0.4 (memories below this score are dropped)
- Domain/feature short-word protection: words ≤4 chars use messageWords.has() only

DECAY: fade_rate * sessions_since_surfaced penalty (capped -0.5), age-based: short_term >7d: -0.2, medium_term >30d: -0.15, ephemeral >3d: -0.3

INTENT: pure keyword classifier, cross-context penalties: -0.25 technical↔personal, -0.2 personal↔technical, -0.15 casual

RESULTS: 0.73 avg per message across 4 projects, 0 false cross-context leaks
